beams.cantilever_end_load.title: Cantilever with an end point load

variables.name: M_max

method_references: Simply supported central-load deflection (standard beam table; recalled)

beams.ss_point_offcenter.title: Simply supported beam with an off-centre point load

variables.name: a
variables.desc: load distance from the left support

variables.name: b
variables.desc: load distance from the right support

assumptions: The span L is checked against a + b (a mismatch raises MechError).
method_references: Simply supported off-centre load: R_A = P·b/L, R_B = P·a/L, M_max = P·a·b/L, δ_load = P·a²·b²/(3·E·I·L) (standard beam table; recalled)

beams.beam_stiffness.title: Equivalent spring stiffness of a beam (k = 3EI/L³, 48EI/L³)

variables.name: k_cant
variables.desc: stiffness of a cantilever with an end load (3EI/L³)

variables.name: k_ss
variables.desc: stiffness of a simply supported central load (48EI/L³)

assumptions: Stiffness k = P/δ for the stated load case; spring-equivalent only near that deformation mode.

beams.moment_area.title: Cantilever end load by the moment-area method
method_references: Moment-area theorems applied to a cantilever end load (agrees with the general solver and double integration; recalled)

beams.castigliano_energy.title: Cantilever end load by Castigliano’s theorem
method_references: Castigliano’s theorem: δ = ∂U/∂P with U = ∫M²/(2EI) dx (agrees with the general solver; recalled)

beams.unit_load.title: Simply supported central load by the unit-load method
method_references: Unit-load method δ = ∫m·M/(EI) dx for a central load (agrees with the general solver; recalled)

beams.deflection_superposition.title: Superpose two deflection contributions
assumptions: Valid for linear-elastic (small-deflection) beams where the contributions are computed independently; add like-signed components.
method_references: Principle of superposition for linear beams (recalled)

beams.general_beam.title: General prismatic beam: reactions, SFD/BMD, slope and deflection

variables.name: loads
variables.desc: rows ["P", P, x] point load (down), ["M", M, x] point moment (CCW +), ["w", w, a, b] uniform load (down), ["lin", wa, wb, a, b] linear load (down); [] for none

variables.name: V
variables.desc: shear force (N), up + on the left face

variables.name: M_fixed
variables.desc: [M, ...] moment reactions at fixed supports (N·m), CCW +

assumptions: Euler–Bernoulli, small deflection, prismatic, linear elastic.
Indeterminate supports (propped, fixed-fixed, continuous) solved by superposition of compatibility conditions in one linear system.
M_max/x_M_max are the first location achieving the maximum magnitude; on a tie (e.g. fixed-fixed) the left-most is reported.
method_references: Singularity (Macaulay) functions; double integration; superposition/compatibility (agrees with the closed-form table cases; recalled)

source.derivation: I = P·L^3/(3E·delta) = 1000·8/(3·200e9·1.66667e-3) = 8e-6 m^4 (with theta = 1.25e-3, M_max = 2000 recovered alongside)

Moment-area: tip slope = area of M/EI diagram = (PL/EI)(L/2) = PL^2/(2EI) = 1.25e-3; tip deflection = first moment = (PL^2/2EI)(2L/3) = PL^3/(3EI) = 1.66667e-3 (equals cantilever_end_load and the general solver)
Castigliano: U = integral_0^L (Px)^2/(2EI) dx = P^2 L^3/(6EI); delta = dU/dP = PL^3/(3EI) = 1.66667e-3 (equals the general solver)
Unit load: delta = integral m M/(EI) dx with m = x/2, M = Px/2 over each half; = PL^3/(48EI) = 8.33333e-3 (equals ss_point_center and the general solver)
Simply supported central load: R = 5000 each; M_max = PL/4 = 10000 at x=2; delta_max = PL^3/(48EI) = 8.33333e-3 at x=2 (agrees with the double-integration closed form ss_point_center)
Cantilever end load: R = 1000 up, fixed-end moment reaction 2000 N·m (CCW), M_max = PL = 2000 at x=0, delta_max = PL^3/(3EI) = 1.66667e-3 (agrees with the moment-area / Castigliano closed forms)

Propped cantilever (indeterminate): by compatibility R_simple = 3wL/8 = 3000, R_fixed = 5wL/8 = 5000, fixed-end moment = wL^2/8 = 4000; delta_max = w/(48EI)·x^2(3L^2 - 5Lx + 2x^2) at x = L(15-sqrt33)/16 = 2.31386 m = 1.73316e-3
Two-span continuous beam (indeterminate): end reactions 3wL/8 = 3000, interior reaction 10wL/8 = 10000; support moment at the middle = -wL^2/8 = -4000 (magnitude 4000) at x=4

Cantilever with the fixed support at the right end (x = 2 m) and a 1 kN tip load at x = 0: the fixed-end moment reaction is P·L = 1000·2 = 2000 N·m, so |M|max = 2000 N·m at x = 2 (the right-end fixed support; the step is evaluated just inside x = L)

Propped cantilever with the fixed support at the right end (x = 4 m) and a 2 kN/m UDL: by compatibility the fixed-end moment is wL^2/8 = 2000·16/8 = 4000 N·m, so |M|max = 4000 N·m at x = 4 (the right-end fixed support; the step is evaluated just inside x = L)
